title: Electrical / Automation Engineer
description:
We need Electrical / Automation Engineer to perform On/Off site work Activities like Manufacturing, Service, Erection & Commissioning of Various Control System/ Panels for our Boiler/ Process Equipment Fabrication division at Malumachampatti, Coimbatore, Tamilnadu.

**Educational Requirements:**

- Degree/ Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical/ Instrumentation Engg.

- Diploma / Entry Level Certification in Automation from any of Approved Institution

- Min. 2yrs. exp. in Automation Activities, Erection & Commissioning of equipments and its all on site activities in any machinery manufacturing Industries.

-Experience in Commissioning of Furnaces & Boilers are highly preferred.

- Able to communicate in English, Tamil & (Hindi is an added Advantage)

**Required Skills :**   
- Able to understand & explore GA, P&I, Electrical Drawings and Instruments User manuals  
- Added Advantage to have knowledge in DCS / SCADA Programming, HMI Screen Development, PLC Programming for various PLC brands esp, for Siemens, Allen Bradley, Horner, Fanuc, Delta etc.

- Highly skilled in Innovative Concept Design and Logic Developments  
- Should have thorough knowledge in Communication Systems & Protocols, System Interfacing and Automation Protocols like EGD, MODBUS, CIP, HART etc.

- Should have thorough knowledge in Computer & Windows Operating System, and knowledgeable in MS Office Packages  
- Must be ready to travel across India about the project for Erection & Commissioning and Service activities

- Must be travel across India for our Machine Erection & Commissioning  
-Should be capable to issue Trials & Training to End Users  
- Must have Knowledge in Documentation of Project

Job Types: Full-time, Walk-In

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Control Panel Assembling, Wiring & Fault Finding: 2 years (Preferred)
* PLC Programming: 2 years (Preferred)
* Siemens PLC, HMI SCADA Programming: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: On the road

title: SDET QA Engineer
description:
**SDET QA Engineer**

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Annual CTC:** ₹ 6 to 7 LPA  
**Job Summary**  
We are looking for a motivated SDET QA Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of our web applications through automation testing. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in UI and API test automation, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-based environments, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites for React-based web applications.
* Design and perform API testing for REST services.
* Build and maintain test automation frameworks using Playwright (preferred) or Cypress.
* Create and maintain automated regression and end-to-end test suites.
* Collaborate with developers to identify, track, and resolve defects.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Participate in code reviews and follow Git best practices.
* Validate applications deployed on AWS and Heroku environments.
* Support testing of Node.js backend services and APIs.
* Contribute to improving test coverage, quality metrics, and release processes.

**Required Skills**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in QA Automation or SDET roles.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with Playwright (preferred) or Cypress.
* Experience in REST API testing using tools such as Postman or automated API test frameworks.
* Experience testing React web applications.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
* Experience working with AWS cloud services.
* Knowledge of Git workflows and pull request/code review practices.
* Familiarity with Node.js applications and backend testing.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience with SQL databases and data validation.
* Knowledge of test reporting and test management tools.
* Experience with Heroku deployments.
* Understanding of modern testing and quality engineering best practices.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹58,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
